scope: REFLECT50 R01-R50 integrated local behavior and exact synthetic payload/storage observations; no total session tokens, cash, QA, latency or bug-free guarantee

implementation.procedure: Inspect all fifty actual deltas and repairs; rerun all named reflection tests on final source.
implementation.acceptance: All current reflection tests and independent scoped checks pass; counts and literal values agree; all fifty actual improvements remain identifiable.

reference_boundary.procedure: Use original literal sections/full JSON and finite token boundaries; preserve source hashes, errors, dependencies and mandatory global sections.
reference_boundary.acceptance: All current reflection tests and independent scoped checks pass; counts and literal values agree; all fifty actual improvements remain identifiable.

data_integrity.procedure: Check every bound source/recipe/raw output/archive hash and keep all failed historical gates and negative controls.
data_integrity.acceptance: All current reflection tests and independent scoped checks pass; counts and literal values agree; all fifty actual improvements remain identifiable.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Independently count actual UTF-8 bytes/o200k_base tokens including native newline; parse both stored JSON receipts and compare complete values.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: All current reflection tests and independent scoped checks pass; counts and literal values agree; all fifty actual improvements remain identifiable.

measurement_validity.procedure: Large selection may reduce payload, tiny selection may cost more; restrict compression to stored JSON whitespace and local synthetic cases.
measurement_validity.acceptance: All current reflection tests and independent scoped checks pass; counts and literal values agree; all fifty actual improvements remain identifiable.

reproducibility.procedure: Independently execute current tests and rebuild deterministic measurement fixtures; compare wire hashes/counts and review actual source.
reproducibility.acceptance: All current reflection tests and independent scoped checks pass; counts and literal values agree; all fifty actual improvements remain identifiable.
